title: Crispy French Courgette Fritters
description: A delicious and crispy French-inspired courgette fritter recipe perfect for a snack or side dish.
instructions: Grate the courgette and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a bowl, combine flour, cheese, egg, milk, salt, and pepper.
Add the grated courgette to the bowl and mix well.
Heat about 1/2 inch (1 cm) of oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the courgette mixture into the oil.
Fry the fritters until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
